==Description==
'''Sleigh Ride''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by Vylith, Jaaziar and MonoGAnim. The emote is looped and cannot be interacted it. It is moveable and no music can be heard while performing the emote.

'''Sleigh Ride''' will make the player move inside a red sleigh which floats above the ground.

This emote could be obtained at Level 34 of the regular track, where it costs {{Bell|1,190}} or {{Robux|158}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Bell|19,030}} or {{Robux|3,670}}.
